notes: Available machines, cable stations, free weights, and gym-specific equipment quirks. The AI agent MUST consult this list when designing or modifying workout routines to ensure suggested exercises can actually be performed.

available_machines.name: Smith Machine
available_machines.notes: Plates only, starting resistance not included. Incline bench notch #11 or #12.

available_machines.name: Pec Deck / Butterfly Machine
available_machines.notes: Clean, controlled reps with peak contraction squeeze.

available_machines.name: Reverse Fly / Rear Delt Machine
available_machines.notes: Sit slightly back, chest to pad, initiate with scapular protraction.

available_machines.name: Cable Station / Functional Trainer
available_machines.notes: Pulleys have a 2:1 mechanical advantage ratio.

available_machines.name: Hyperextension / 45° Back Extension Bench
available_machines.notes: Use plates or dumbbells for added resistance.

free_weights_and_bars.name: Trap Bar / Hex Bar
free_weights_and_bars.notes: 20kg bar + Olympic weight plates. Used for Trap Bar Deadlifts.

free_weights_and_bars.name: Olympic Barbells & Plates
free_weights_and_bars.notes: Standard 20kg bars, curl bars, Olympic plates.

free_weights_and_bars.name: Dumbbells
free_weights_and_bars.notes: Full dumbbell rack. Used for Bulgarian Split Squats, Incline Rows, Lateral Raises, Curls.

unavailable_or_lacking: Hack Squat machine (use Leg Press or Smith Squat instead)
